title: Protection paladin: Righteous Fury stays up through the fight

rules.desc: The Protection paladin holds Righteous Fury (aura 25780) for at least 95 percent of its in-combat samples
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/paladin/ProtectionPaladinStrategy.cpp:241-262 (righteous fury rows in and out of combat, ACTION_NORMAL + 1); ai/playerbot/strategy/paladin/PaladinTriggers.h:66 (RighteousFuryTrigger = BUFF_TRIGGER); ai/playerbot/strategy/paladin/PaladinActions.h:59; ai/playerbot/strategy/paladin/PaladinAiObjectContext.cpp:75-77 (buff protection pve/pvp/raid)
rules.why_expect: the non-combat row puts the buff up before the pull and the combat row re-casts it if it drops (30 min duration, so it should never fall off in a 180 s fight)

rules.desc: At most 30 percent of all mob damage lands on the healer or the DPS player
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/paladin/ProtectionPaladinStrategy.cpp:46-49 (lose aggro -> hand of reckoning at ACTION_MOVE, judgement at ACTION_MOVE - 1), :18 (hand of reckoning -> righteous defense); ai/playerbot/strategy/triggers/GenericTriggers.cpp:289-320
rules.why_expect: the paladin taunt row sits at ACTION_MOVE, far below the warrior's INTERRUPT+1, and its alternative Righteous Defense is not a 1.12 spell; whether Hand of Reckoning is known at level 40 on this core is not proven. Compare with TNK-WAR-MOBS-ON-TANK

rules.desc: Precondition: Battle Stance (aura 2457) stays on the player through the fight, so the role read by the bot is the one this trial is about
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: the stance is read by ai/playerbot/AiFactory.cpp:446-471 (GetPlayerRoles) unless the forced role decides first (ai/playerbot/PlayerbotAI.cpp:3986-3990)
rules.why_expect: setup check player_stance proves the stance at the start; the runner's threat cast every 6 s keeps the player in the stance's rotation
